facts.fact: At a launch workshop on 19 July 2024 the local NGO FVS-Amade said it will give the civil registry service of Rumonge commune computers, tablets, solar panels and routers to ease its connection, at the commune seat and in its zones, under a one-year project; the provision is announced, not reported as done.
facts.system: connection of the civil registry service of Rumonge commune (routers from FVS-Amade)

facts.fact: The routers and other equipment for the connection of Rumonge commune's civil registry service are to be supplied by the local NGO FVS-Amade under a one-year project, as its programme officer said on 19 July 2024.

facts.fact: Workshop participants on 19 July 2024 said Rumonge commune could not keep digital registration going once FVS-Amade's support ends; the NGO is the only funder the article names.
